ActionConfiguration.description:
Client configuration, the create body. Ownership and execution state are
server-owned.

description.description: What the routine is for, in the owner's words; empty when unset.

run_visibility.description: Omitted by clients that predate the setting; runs then start unlisted.

ActionConfigurationUpdate.description:
Configuration replacement, the update body. Activation has its own endpoint, so
omitting `enabled` keeps the stored value; omitting `run_visibility` or
`description` keeps them too, so clients that predate them do not reset them.

enabled.description: Still sent by clients deployed before the activation endpoint.

resource_id.description:
ID of the primary resource produced by this run. Its type is recorded in
`result`, independently of the routine's current configuration.

oneOf.description: Fires once at `at`, or as soon as it is saved when `at` has passed.

ActionTrigger.description: A routine may run on one trigger or any of several schedules and Macro events.

AgentMcpServer.description:
One Pipedream app an agent lists under [`AgentMcpServers::Selected`].

Only the catalog identity is stored. Whether a given person has connected
the app is theirs, resolved at call time by the egress proxy, never here.

AgentTask.description:
The single agent task: how routines were stored before they had steps,
and still how a routine that is only an agent is saved.

oneOf.description: Absent when using Macro's agent-session runtime with a selected model.

mcp_servers.description:
Apps the routine requires on top of the agent's own. The owner must
have each one connected to save the routine and for it to run.

oneOf.description: Required for model targets; overrides the persona default for agent targets.

AgentTaskAgent.description: A persona selection, independent of its runtime and current default model.

AiAdmissionErrorBody.description:
Public admission error payload. Handlers with additional fields can reuse the
domain error's code and message and [`admission_status`].

error.description: Human-readable explanation, without internal billing diagnostics.

CodeIdentity.description: Who a routine's code steps write as.

CodeUpgrade.description: One time a routine's code was brought to a new SDK.

fromSdk.description: The SDK the code was checked against before; none when it never was.

reason.description: Why the routine needs its owner.

task.description: The saved rewrite, or the rewrite that failed its checks.

toSdk.description: The SDK it was brought to.

oneOf.description: The triggering content answered the condition with no.

probability.description: The classifier's probability, from 0 to 1, that the answer was yes.

oneOf.description: The condition could not be checked before the retry window closed.

ConditionResult.description: Why an event-triggered run was skipped before it started.

allOf.description: A routine to review before saving.

oneOf.description: A routine to review before saving.

allOf.description: A step to add, or to put in place of the one changed.

oneOf.description: A step to add, or to put in place of the one changed.
Why there's no draft, for the person.

Draft.description: What AI drafted, or why it couldn't.

DraftContext.description: What the drafter may write, and the person's workspace by name and id.

agentModel.description: The model Ask AI steps it writes run on.

code.description:
Whether it may write code steps; otherwise it writes Ask AI steps.
Changing a code step needs no permission.

conditions.description:
Whether triggers may ask AI a yes/no question before a run. This host
must also be able to answer it.

timezone.description: IANA time zone schedules are written in, e.g. `America/New_York`.

oneOf.description: A new routine, from what it should do and when.

One step to add at the end of `routine`. `kind` makes it code or Ask
AI; without it, AI makes it code whenever code can do the job.

The code step at `index` in `routine`'s steps, rewritten as
`instruction` says. It keeps its place and output name.

DraftRoutineRequest.description: What to draft, and what the drafter may write and name.

problems.description: Steps whose code still fails the type checker.

steps.description:
What it does, in the shape a routine's task holds steps, each code
step named as saving names it.

oneOf.description: When it runs; absent when AI found no trigger it could use.

problems.description: What the type checker still finds in its code.

reason.description:
Why AI made a step it chose code or Ask AI, in a few words; empty
when it gave no short reason or didn't choose.

step.description: The step, in the shape a routine's task holds it.

EmptyResponse.description: Empty response is required due to custom fetch forcing `response.json()`

EventFilter.description:
An event name AND an entity ID must match within the same filter. A
condition further requires the event's content to answer it with yes.

`github` comes from outside Macro and carries its payload: it stands
alone in its filter, takes no ids, and may require
exact payload values with `match`. A `github` filter narrows deliveries
with its `github` selector.

condition.description:
Yes/no question about the triggering content, e.g. "Is this email an
invoice?". The routine runs only when the answer is yes.

oneOf.description: Which GitHub deliveries match; required for, and only for, `github`.

match.description: Exact tests on the payload, all of which must pass.

oneOf.description: The task property that must have changed, and the values it must gain.

EventFilters.description: Bounded nonempty OR of filters, canonicalized to remove duplicates.

EventName.description:
Closed allowlist: unknown names, deletions and ambiguous attribution are not
selectors. Adding a broker variant does not automatically enable routines.

ExecutionResource.description: Transcript resource created by a run. Never infer this from current task configuration.

ExecutionResourceType.description: Closed set of transcript destinations understood by routine clients.

ExecutionResult.description:
Version 1 execution metadata stored in the existing JSON result column.
Null/string column values predate this envelope and refer to legacy chats.

oneOf.description: Present when an event trigger's condition stopped the run from starting.

configuration_revision.description:
The routine configuration the run used. Step paths only name the same
steps in that configuration; a later edit can put another step there.

oneOf.description: What started the run and when, for runs of programs.

steps.description: What each step that ran did, in order: decisions, tool calls, the agent.

actions.description: Payload actions, such as `completed` or `opened`; any when empty.

events.description: GitHub event names, such as `workflow_run` or `pull_request`; any when empty.

includeBots.description: Also run for deliveries caused by bots and apps, including Macro's own.

repositories.description:
Repositories as `owner/name`, matched without regard to case; every
repository the owner's installations cover when empty. A renamed
repository stops matching until it is chosen again.

oneOf.description: Absent only in responses from legacy workers.

PayloadCondition.description:
`path` walks objects by key; `*` steps into every element of an array and
a number into one. Give exactly one test. `notIn` also passes when the
path finds nothing.

oneOf.description: Some value found equals this.

exists.description: Whether the path finds a non-null value.

glob.description: Some text found matches this glob; `*` matches any run of characters.

in.description: Some value found is one of these.

notIn.description: No value found is one of these.

path.description: Keys from the payload's root, e.g. `["workflow_run", "conclusion"]`.

PayloadScalar.description: A JSON text, number, boolean or null that payload values are compared with.

PropertySelector.description:
Narrows a task property change filter to one property and, optionally, the
values it must gain.

definitionId.description: The property definition that must have changed.

values.description:
Select option ids or referenced entity ids, one of which the change must
add. Any change to the property matches when empty.

RoutineModelId.description: A nonblank model identifier. Runtime catalogs, not the scheduler, own availability.

RoutineSoFar.description: The routine a step is added to or changed in.

steps.description: Its steps, in the shape a routine's task holds them.

trigger.description: Its trigger as it would be saved, for AI to read; absent while it has none.

RoutineTemplate.description: A shared routine's snapshot, readable by signed-in users with sharing enabled.

active_count.description: Routines activated from this template, including stopped ones.

author.description: Who shared it: the source routine's owner.

id.description: The routine it was shared from.

oneOf.description: Fires once at `at`, or as soon as it is saved when `at` has passed.

RoutineTrigger.description: An individual trigger in a routine's trigger list.

RoutineTriggers.description: Bounded schedules and one combined set of event filters.

RunInfo.description:
What the run page says about a run: what started it, when it counts as
happening, and since when.

at.description: When the run counts as happening: its trigger's time.

oneOf.description:
Who its code steps' writes were attributed to; absent when it had no
code steps, and on runs recorded before this was.

previous_at.description: When the routine's previous finished run started.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone code reads `at` in, when the run had one.

oneOf.description: One of its schedules came due.
An event it watches happened.

entity_id.description: The item the event is about.

oneOf.description: Its owner started it by hand.

RunStart.description: What started a run, for its page.

RunVisibility.description:
Whether a routine's runs are listed in Home and the Agents list. Routines
that run often would bury the owner's own work, so runs start unlisted;
either way they stay in the routine's history. The string form is the
`scheduled_action.run_visibility` column's.

description.description: What the routine is for, in the owner's words; empty when unset.

enabled.description:
When false, automatic dispatch skips this action. `run_now` remains
available regardless.

event_activated_at.description: Event publication boundary; absent for cron actions.

next_run_at.description: Next cron firing, absent for event-triggered actions.

owner.description:
Who the action belongs to. Every action is user-owned today, but the
type no longer says so: the principal string on the wire and in the
`owner` column is the same, and a bot- or team-owned row decodes
rather than failing to parse.

run_visibility.description: Whether the action's runs are listed in Home and the Agents list.

template_id.description: The shared template this routine was activated from, if any.

oneOf.description:
The latest finished run, with what each step did. Present only in
lists, and only once the routine has finished a run.

schedule.description: Deprecated: use `trigger.schedule`. Present only for cron actions.

timezone.description: Deprecated: use `trigger.timezone`. Present only for cron actions.

ScheduledActionResponse.description:
Canonical trigger plus deprecated cron fields for existing clients. Event
responses omit legacy fields rather than inventing a schedule or timezone.

ScheduledActionUpdate.description:
Live status update for a scheduled-action run, broadcast via the connection
gateway to the owner. Clients use the typed resource to navigate to the run
transcript and the variant tag to toggle the running indicator. `chat_id`
remains populated only for chat runs, for older clients.

Serialized with a `type` tag (`started`/`stopped`) and delivered over the
single `scheduled_action_update` message type on the gateway.

ShareRoutineTemplate.description: What the owner supplies when sharing; the rest is snapshotted from the routine.

StarterRoutine.description:
A starter routine whose step is code: offered when a routine is created,
and shown to the drafter as a worked example.

request.description: What someone asks for, with when it runs.

steps.description: Its steps, in the shape a routine's task holds them.

StepKind.description: Code written once, or Ask AI each run.

StepProblem.description: A drafted step whose code still fails the type checker.

index.description: Its place among the steps, from zero.

oneOf.description: A person mentioned in the instructions, by their user ID.
A document, channel or other item mentioned in the instructions.

block_name.description: The mention's block name, such as `channel` or `md`.

oneOf.description: The time zone of the routine's schedules.

TemplateVariable.description: A user-specific part of a shared routine.

VariableFill.description: How a variable is filled when someone activates the template.

Workspace.description:
The items AI may name in a draft. They are data for the model; saving
checks every id the draft uses.

agents.description: Agents a step may hand the run to.

tags.description: Tag options, by the property definition they belong to.

WorkspaceAgent.description: An agent and its bot id.

WorkspaceTag.description: A tag: one option of a property.
